description: This bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT's QA performance and ground-truth versus generated answers across three domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, while the vertical axis, labeled "Correlation," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays four distinct bar types, each representing a different correlation metric: Pop_GT (solid orange), Pop_Ge (hatched orange), RPop_GT (solid blue), and RPop_Ge (hatched blue), as indicated by the legend in the top right. For each domain, four bars are grouped together, with Pop_GT and RPop_GT bars appearing taller than their corresponding Pop_Ge and RPop_Ge counterparts. Specifically, for Movies, Pop_GT correlates at approximately 0.22, Pop_Ge at approximately 0.11, RPop_GT at approximately 0.35, and RPop_Ge at approximately 0.63. For Songs, Pop_GT correlates at approximately 0.30, Pop_Ge at approximately 0.10, RPop_GT at approximately 0.50, and RPop_Ge at approximately 0.70. For Basketball, Pop_GT correlates at approximately 0.08, Pop_Ge at approximately 0.08, RPop_GT at approximately 0.15, and RPop_Ge at approximately 0.22. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the domains. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
